description: This file contains utility methods related to fuel injection and engine control for the rusEfi project. It includes functions for testing injectors, fuel pumps, fans, and ignition coils, as well as managing injector states and running bench tests. The code is intended for embedded firmware controlling engine hardware components.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents an output pin for controlling hardware components such as injectors, relays, or ignition coils.
